mechanism: Carisoprodol is hepatically metabolized and leflunomide undergoes enterohepatic circulation with potential for additive hepatotoxicity; carisoprodol's CNS depressant effects may be enhanced in patients with compromised hepatic function from leflunomide.
action: Monitor liver function tests periodically; use carisoprodol cautiously in patients on leflunomide and counsel on avoiding additional CNS depressants; consider alternative muscle relaxants if hepatic impairment develops.
